scope: Independent review and feasibility notes only; no new patient SNP pileup or large scan executed.

old_cross_assay.selection_bias: Selected from this DNA VCF with rs/Benign filters and reported ALT fraction>=98%, then further conditioned on DNA high-ALT and both assays depth>=20. Not a population-selected identity panel.

population_panel.selection: Public1000G GRCh38 biallelic PASS SNVs, globalAF0.05-0.95, reference allele checked; exons+100bp, named focal-gene regions and dispersed grid on six selected autosomes. No patient ALT evidence selects sites. SAS_AF recorded but not a selection criterion.

existing_DNA_only_table.warning: This is not the full panel and contains no RNA recount. Add missing public-panel sites as zero observed counts rather than dropping them.

prior_work.not_already_done: Search of relevant analysis scripts, methods and findings found DNA-only public-panel recount/LOH work, and the earlier VCF-selected cross-assay check; no earlier full population-selected DNA/RNA compatibility comparison.

alignment_inventory.new_alignment_limit: The recent whole-reference STAR run retained only four targeted gene intervals in BAM; it cannot replace the original full RNA BAM for this panel.
alignment_inventory.residency: Both original BAMs presently appear resident regular files outside iCloud. Workspace DNA index was dataless initially but opened successfully; preserve a verified small resident index copy to avoid repeat hydration.

proposed_design_review.universe: Approve full165782-site universe, all six chromosomes, with public REF and contig-length checks before new RNA allele counts. Save panel hash and no outcome-driven site removals.
proposed_design_review.counting: Approve matched prior DNA rules: MAPQ>=30,BQ>=25,proper pair,exclude0xF0C; disable automatic overlap correction; collapse qualified observations by query name and discard conflicting ACGT observations at that locus. Single RG per assay supports reproducing the existing name-only counter. Report A/C/G/T counts, other/nonACGT, discordant and no-coverage counts; names are not independent UMI molecules. Recount BOTH original DNA and RNA BAMs uncapped with identical rules after installed -d0 semantics are demonstrated; compare new DNA counts against every old observed DNA row, documenting all discrepancies.
proposed_design_review.assessability: Joint >=20 unambiguous ACGT query names is an operational floor, not a precision/power guarantee. Use all ACGT denominator, not REF+ALT renormalization that hides third-base evidence. Excluded/depth-capped/reference-mismatch sites remain in attrition.
proposed_design_review.categories: Symmetric DNA near-reference>=98% and near-alternate>=98%, mixed REF and ALT each>=10% with combined>=95%, and residual category are acceptable descriptive strata. These are observed tumor allele-dominance categories, not validated diploid germline genotypes. Keep all jointly callable categories in the main table.
proposed_design_review.RNA_comparison: Report RNA same DNA-dominant allele at90% and98% separately. Strong triage rule bothdepth>=50, unexpectedRNA>=10% and>=10 names withDNA<=2% is a defensible screening flag. Label allele-fraction discordance, not identity incompatibility. DNA-mixed to RNA-monoallelic is biologically plausible and not an exclusion or mismatch verdict.
proposed_design_review.breadth_gate: Requested floors100 near-homozygous jointly callable sites,20 perreference/alternate category,4chromosomes,20one-Mb bins and30gene labels are acceptable feasibility gates only. Missing a floor means limited breadth; it does not mean a mismatch, and thresholds must not be relaxed to get a favorable conclusion.
proposed_design_review.dispersion: Freeze coordinate-first >=50kb selection independent of observed allele direction or RNA agreement. Report whether it is applied to the full public panel or jointly depth-callable subset; ideally present the full-panel-preselected subset, with callable attrition, as well as a separately labelled depth-conditioned thin subset if useful. Never choose favorable markers. Summarize chromosome, 1Mb bins, nearest-neighbor distances, focal-region strata and actual overlapping gene membership; 50kb does not establish linkage independence.
proposed_design_review.gene_breadth: Count actual nonmissing GENCODE gene IDs with explicit overlap rules; do not count intergenic placeholders or nearest-gene guesses as independent genes. Multiple overlapping gene labels at one SNP should not artificially inflate the breadth gate.
proposed_design_review.old_overlap: Record exact intersection with the earlier335 selected loci; six-autosome panel does not retest the prior chrX ZRSR2/pseudogene exception. DifferentBQ/edge filters mean new counts need not equal the old assay counts.
proposed_design_review.independent_recount: Prefer all joint sites if manageable with coalesced intervals. Otherwise freeze a deterministic300-site control sample balanced across DNA categories/chromosomes/bins plus every strong discordance up to20. Select that validation subset for audit breadth, not as a new discovery denominator; record the cap and deterministic priority before mechanistic follow-up.
proposed_design_review.sensitivity: Direct CIGAR recount on reviewed sites should check no-softclip and>=5nt from both aligned read ends, and mapping-quality/NH sensitivity. Avoid requiring DNA MAPQ60 in RNA: STAR unique alignments commonly use255. Compare unique-mapping tags and thresholds in an aligner-aware way. Nearby indel/splice-boundary reads deserve review at discordant loci.
proposed_design_review.homology: MAPQ/NH is not proof of unique molecular origin. Review paralogs/pseudogenes and normal splice context for discordances; report baseline and qualified counts without silently deleting disagreeing loci. A matching local sequence is not enough to prove originating gene or RNA-editing mechanism.

cap_handling_refinement.issue: A pileup depth ceiling may be applied before base-quality filtering, so reported qualified depth below the configured maximum alone may not establish that the site was uncapped.
cap_handling_refinement.old_run_context: The six-chromosome prior DNA mpileup finished in59.0seconds with191MB peakRSS; this is evidence of local feasibility, not a guaranteed RNA runtime or cap safety proof.
cap_handling_refinement.accepted_resolution: Recount BOTH assays with installed mpileup -d0 only after documenting that it disables the depth cap in this installed implementation. Use an explicit per-process RSS/disk guard. Compare the resulting DNA A/C/G/T, discordant and other counts with all 62358 prior observed rows, and retain zero rows for all other frozen-panel positions. Do not infer absence of old capping from qualified output depth.
cap_handling_refinement.pre_execution_qualification: Installed help reports the depth option but does not document zero semantics. Before patient counts, retain a small public/synthetic capped-vs-uncapped control or exact installed source evidence confirming -d0, plus argument/parser smoke checks. A control should contain depth above a deliberately small positive cap, overlapping agreeing and conflicting mates, strand reversal, quality filtering and non-ACGT cases; this validates execution, not biological accuracy.

feasibility.expected_compute: Two fresh guarded counts, one DNA and one RNA, across the frozen six-chromosome panel. Stream stdout into aggregate counters without saving large raw text. Checkpoint one chromosome to estimate runtime/RSS, then continue under the frozen limits. No realignment, new genome index or new downloads are required.
feasibility.resource_plan: One or two CPU threads; target<2GiBRSS; do not materialize huge uncompressed QNAME pileup files or duplicate BAMs. Save per-site aggregate counts and compressed private evidence only if needed.

inference_limits: Population-selected sites improve ascertainment but this is still an expression/capture/callability-selected tumor comparison over six targeted chromosomes.
Linked SNPs, shared reads, chromosome-scale allelic imbalance and common alleles preclude independent-site/binomial assumptions.

Allele-specific expression, tumor/normal admixture, differential cell composition, transcript-specific expression, sequencing errors and mapping ambiguity can change DNA/RNA fractions without a sample mismatch.
No chance-match probability, contamination fraction, ancestry, relatedness, tumor-retention claim, clinical identity certification or treatment change is justified.
Preserve v2 completed artifacts and use only this new analysis directory for follow-up evidence.
approval_conditions: Freeze final design/hash and exact inputs before new patient counts.
Qualify installed uncapped semantics and overlap/parser behavior using public or synthetic data; no patient pilot can substitute for that semantics check.
Retain all 165782 sites and full assay/callability/category attrition, symmetric REF/ALT strata, and actual-gene breadth.
Preserve baseline disagreements through clean-read/paralog sensitivity review; no post hoc favorable exclusions.
Report allele-fraction consistency/discordance only, with no identity probability or contamination estimate.
